purpose: Resolve Cairo CG 53465-53469 against the 1902 Nesbanebdjedet burial at Mendes, identify the documented gold phallus sheath among the surviving museum records if possible, and tighten the Osirian contextual link without promoting a human funerary object to a divine relic.

direct_context_upgrade.burial: 1902 Egyptian Antiquities Service excavation, Tell el-Roba / Mendes

independent_museum_inscription_witnesses.fact: The shabti inscription identifies Nesbanebdjed as Prophet of Osiris in Anpet, overseer of wab-priests of Sekhmet in Mendes, and Prophet of the Ram Lord of Mendes, born to Shentyt.
The inscription independently gives prophet of Osiris in Anpet (Thmuis), Mendes/Sekhmet office, prophet of Banebdjed, Nesbanebdjed born to Shentyt.

direct_context_upgrade.interpretation: The owner of the exact 1902 assemblage containing the documented gold phallus sheath held an explicit Osiris priestly title in addition to Mendes/Banebdjedet offices. This strengthens context, not identity.
direct_context_upgrade.hard_caveat: A priestly title of Osiris does not transform the deceased priest's personal gold phallus sheath into a relic of Osiris.

met_group_binding.fact: The Met records the 1902 Mendes burial with more than 360 shabtis, fragments and amulets above the chamber, and a mummy below adorned with gold-leaf trappings, explicitly referring to Cairo CG 53465-53469.

vernier_catalogue.author: Émile Vernier
vernier_catalogue.title: Catalogue général des antiquités égyptiennes du Musée du Caire: Bijoux et orfèvreries
vernier_catalogue.ocr_capability: BnF documents Gallica ContentSearch, texteBrut and ALTO OCR services for ARK documents.
vernier_catalogue.current_access_result: Exact public OCR hits for CG 53465-53469 were not exposed by the present indexed search/tool route; no mapping is guessed.

identity_control.rule: Do not merge same-name Nesbanebdjed individuals unless mother name, titles, chronology and excavation provenance match.

institutional_resolution_package.target: Egyptian Museum Cairo object-card / conservation archive
request_scope: X-radiography, CT or other non-destructive imaging references if any
cross-reference to Quibell 1902 Tell er-Roba burial

next_gate.success_condition: At least one CG number is securely mapped to a Quibell-described gold object, ideally identifying the gold phallus sheath and its current museum identity.
next_gate.fallback: If public OCR remains blocked, resolve through published catalogue page images or authorized museum correspondence.
